trigger.reason: Phase 9A found MPI-INF-3DHP RGB media, relevant source code, checkpoints, and a CUDA GPU, while prior controlled-noise work showed that clean-2D gains do not automatically transfer to detector noise.

detectors.person_selection: highest mean keypoint confidence; no ground-truth-assisted selection
highest detector confidence; no ground-truth-assisted selection

coco17_policy.head: nose proxy; reported separately because anatomical definitions differ

alignment_policy.offset_selection: maximize exact frame-number overlap independently for each subject/sequence/camera group

video_media_policy.annotation_alignment: decoded video frame index maps to the same zero-based row index in the processed annotation bundle; the published frame number is retained as sample identity
video_media_policy.sampling_rule: indices 0, step, 2*step, ... per subject/sequence/camera, with step=round(sequence_fps/5)
video_media_policy.decode_probe: first, middle, and final frame of every video

metrics.normalizer: ground-truth pelvis-to-neck torso length in pixels

interpretation_limits: This phase characterizes real detector errors and creates a locked cache; it does not claim improved 3D pose.
Camera coverage must be reported exactly. A one-camera RGB subset must not be described as full 14-camera RGB coverage.
The available 16-video package supports camera 0 across all 16 subject/sequence groups. It is a subject-complete single-camera development audit, not a full multiview RGB benchmark.
Decoded video frames are used directly without extraction or RGB recompression.
The head result is secondary because COCO nose and MPI-INF-3DHP head joints are not anatomically identical.
No Official TS1-TS6 result may influence detector, threshold, architecture, or training choices.
The output cache is intended for a separately locked confidence-aware V2 training phase.
